## Purpose
`/playground`: chat directly with any model. It has sessions, a model picker, attachments (up to five, each shown with how it will be sent), and settings (temperature and other options, streaming).

## Responsibilities
`PlaygroundPage`:
- sessions from `stores/sessions`, shown in `ChatSessionSidebar`;
- `MessageList`, `Composer` and `AttachmentChip`;
- `ModelPicker`, which adopts the configured default once it arrives unless the user already picked;
- a settings panel with selects and switches;
- a resizable side panel.

Titled "Playground — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`PlaygroundPage`.

## Control flow
Chat streaming through the chat API.

## Data, state and side effects
Local storage sessions.

## Configuration
Models from the Settings page.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `/api/chat/completions` (streaming) and `/api/uploads/*`.

## Error handling and edge cases
- **A reply that failed or was stopped before its first word has no text.** Mistral refuses an empty assistant message, so it is left out of the history, including for sessions saved before this check.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Attachments travel as references.** The backend turns each into what the model accepts.
- **It shows what the chosen model accepts per file kind.**

## How to rebuild this file
As described.

## Tests
`backend/tests/test_chat_playground.py` covers the backend half.
